retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1980s cinematic look featuring a central figure in leather against a cool-toned urban nightscape, anchored by aggressive red script and geometric typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male figure in a black leather jacket, positioned centrally in front of a large window overlooking a blurred, blue-toned nocturnal cityscape. The lighting is dramatic, with cool blue rim light and deep shadows, contrasted by a bold red typographic lockup in the lower third.
coreVisualRelationships: Cool blue background vs. warm red foreground text
Sharp central figure vs. soft bokeh city lights
Organic hand-drawn script vs. rigid geometric sans-serif
Horizontal rule line dividing the lower typographic block
coreInvariants: Deep black shadows in the leather jacket

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-close-up of a male figure, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red script title in the lower third acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down the leather jacket to the red script, and finally to the metadata text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, shadowy areas in the lower corners and the upper window frame provide breathing room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep midnight blue and black (background and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between dark shadows and bright highlights; high saturation only in the red accent.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to blue, red, black, and white

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a fast, aggressive brush script with sharp terminals
Secondary title uses a wide-tracked geometric sans-serif with diamond-shaped bullets
Metadata uses a clean, rounded geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'f' in the script has an elongated crossbar that acts as a horizontal strike
Diamond glyphs used as spacers between letters in the secondary title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive handwritten script paired with ultra-wide geometric sans-serif for a high-tension retro feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic portrait of a man in a black leather jacket standing in front of a window at night. The background should be a blurred city skyline in deep blues. Use high-contrast lighting with blue rim lights and heavy film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large red brush-script title in the lower third. Below it, add a thin white horizontal line. Under the line, place a second title in wide-tracked red geometric sans-serif with diamond bullets between letters. Add white metadata text at the very top and bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the red script overlapping the subject slightly?
Is the background city light sufficiently blurred (bokeh)?
Is the film grain visible across the entire image?
Is the tracking on the secondary title extremely wide?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the horizontal rule line
mustRedesign: Do not replicate existing movie logos
Ensure all text is original and not copied from the source
postGenerationChecks: Verify the geometric sans-serif is wide-tracked
Check for the presence of the horizontal rule
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Noir = (Midnight Blue Cityscape + Leather Subject) * (Aggressive Red Script / Wide Geometric Sans) + Heavy Film Grain
